messages:
Michelle: Quick reminder 1 All-hands this Friday 10:00am PT (same Zoom). Tentative agenda: incident recap + learnings, Redwood Optimize roadmap update, hosted API data-retention policy change, Q&A + open mic. Drop questions here or in #all-hands-questions by Thu EOD. Slides and recording after the meeting. :calendar: :loudspeaker:
Devin: Will the policy section show exact SLA language updates? need clarity for Dedicated customers.
Michelle: yes. No uptime SLA changes; primarily retention defaults and export timelines. We'll walk through the exact phrasing.
Raj: Does this retention update apply to Private (VPC/on-prem)?
Michelle: Private remains customer-managed. Change only affects Hosted API defaults. Dedicated can opt for custom retention via contract.
Sarah: Could we include a short FAQ slide tailored for CS and sales?
Emily: I'll own the FAQ slide. DM me urgent Qs.
OpsBot: Incident 2026-03-18-14: us-west worker autoscaler bug caused ~22m partial outage. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/2026-03-18-14. Please review.
Jorge: For the incident notes, please include mitigation steps and timeline so eng teams know follow-ups.
Samir: I'll add the rollout/checklist snippet we used for mitigation to the slides.
Michelle: Good 1 we'll add mitigation timeline + checklist excerpt.
Devin: Any updates to customer communication templates post-outage?
Sarah: Comms updated the template; will share before the meeting.
Raj: A few enterprise customers asked about export SLAs. Can we add a slide on export process & timelines?
Michelle: Added that to the agenda.
Emily: Product folks: what's the GA target for Optimize? month or week helps sales.
Michelle: Target month: June. We'll show the canary roll plan and expected milestones.
Devin: I'll bring a pricing question re: Dedicated burst capacity.
Samir: Posting the autoscaler code snippet into the incident slides.
Sarah: Logistics: mute on entry, cameras encouraged. We'll run ~40m briefing + 15m open Q&A; use the Q&A panel or raise hand.
Michelle: If you can't attend, mark "regrets" and we'll send the recording.
Jorge: Please make slides accessible (alt text). Design will help.
Emily: Confirmed 1 accessibility checks on slides.
Michelle: Action items: Emily to draft FAQ & accessibility, Samir to add rollout checklist, Sarah to share updated comms template, Devin to bring pricing questions, Ops to finalize postmortem link.
Sarah: TL;DR takeaways for teams: - Incident resolved; postmortem up for review. - Hosted API retention defaults updating (no change to uptime SLA). - Optimize: target June GA window + canary plan. - Dedicated/Private unaffected by retention defaults; export/contract options exist. - Slides + recording posted after the meeting.
Devin: +1 to TL;DR.
Michelle: Placeholder recording link (will post after meeting): https://zoom.redwood/recording/abcd1234
OpsBot: Reminder: review incident draft and leave comments by Thu 5pm PT.
Emily: Draft FAQ is here: https://docs.redwood/internal/all-hands/faq-draft (comments welcome).
Raj: I'll add detailed export SLA notes.
Samir: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Michelle: Closing thread 1 add late questions in #all-hands-questions or DM me.
